correctness.rationale: With rank n-1 incidence, each feasible syndrome has exactly 2^(M-n+1) graphs. The character expansion yields equation (1) with the exact factor (1+i)^M/2^(M+1). Krawtchouk coefficients collapse to three even-n cases and one signed nonzero odd-n case. Triangle symmetric difference forces vanishing even-edge parity character. Four-point inversion yields exact residue laws. Independently checked integer Gaussian expectations and finite graph fibers: 45 symbolic/parameter pairs and 60 exhaustive fiber configurations totaling 33,864 graphs; the proof covers all n>=3.

value.rationale: Identifies a natural exact conditional-independence phenomenon: for every even graph order and any nonconstant feasible complete degree-parity pattern, four edge-count residue classes are exactly equal. Exhaustively classifies exceptional parity patterns and odd graph orders with explicit nonzero bias. The precise qualitative zero criterion is not inferred from standalone degree parity marginal uniformity or from generic finite verification; it is relevant to parity-constrained graph sampling, congruence leakage and cycle-space enumeration.
